description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and Poland on Transfer of Sentenced Persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Transfer of Offenders Act, No.5 of 1995 has made provision for a citizen of another country convicted and sentenced to imprisonment by a Court in Sri Lanka to serve his sentence in the country of which he claims to be a citizen. Likewise, the said Act has also provided for a Sri Lankan citizen who is imprisoned in a specific country to be transferred back to Sri Lanka to serve his balance period of imprisonment. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Transfer of Sentenced Persons, between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Poland, enabling convicted persons to serve their imprisonment in their country and facilitating their rehabilitation, was approved by the Cabinet.
